fp.fragment: Functions are values; lambdas, HOFs, nesting, currying

oop.fragment: Every value is an object; classes, traits, mixin composition

oop.price: Mixin linearisation and identity still exist.

decl.reason: Scala is OO plus FP. Declaration is not the primary evaluation model.

actor.reason: stdlib actors were removed. Akka is a Lightbend library, not the language.

static.why: Reject incoherent abstractions at compile time.

strong.why: Keep abstractions coherent without runtime casts as the default.

hm.reason: Inference is local, deliberately not global Hindley–Milner.

sources.quote: Type inference in Scala is essentially local, in contrast to the more global Hindley-Milner algorithm used in Haskell, ML and other more purely functional languages.
Type inference means the user is not required to annotate code with redundant type information.

dep.reason: Path-dependent types are not Π/Σ dependent types.

sources.quote: Types and behaviors of objects are described by classes and traits.

gen.fragment: Generic classes with type parameters; invariance by default

sources.quote: Generic classes are classes which take a type as a parameter. They are particularly useful for collection classes.
